items.title: Santander bolsters AI capabilities through NVDIA
items.snippet: Banco Santander today announced a new milestone in their artificial intelligence collaboration with NVIDIA.

items.title: Exchange Data International launches global economic calendar
items.snippet: Exchange Data International (EDI), a leading provider of global financial data, has launched its Global Economic Calendar, providing financial professionals with structured access to key economic indicators and scheduled data releases from around the world.

items.title: Blevins Franks selects Palindrome for cross-border wealth advice
items.snippet: Agentic AI specialist Palindrome is pleased to announce it has partnered with cross-border wealth manager Blevins Franks to support its new initiative for UK advisers with clients in Europe.

Zilch to move to new London HQ
items.snippet: UK payments fintech unicorn Zilch has announced details of its new base in London which will more than double the capacity of current HQ as the company looks to expand in Europe.

items.title: PayMore to launch on Google Play
items.snippet: PayMore (paymore.io), the consumer mobile app that gives GCC users prepaid virtual cards for online shopping, subscriptions and digital services, today announced that its Android app is launching soon on Google Play.

items.title: PingPong partners with Getnet for LatAm expansion
items.snippet: PingPong, the intelligent payments infrastructure for global growth, today announces a strategic partnership with Getnet, the leading AI-payments company, part of Santander Group, to expand access to its financial infrastructure across Iberia.

items.title: MKI Partners expands in Latin America
items.snippet: MKI Global Partners (MKI), the independent advisory firm specialising in complex situations, has established an emerging markets practice with an initial focus on Latin America.

items.title: Specialist Mortgage Group embeds Y3S platform
items.snippet: Curvestone AI, the AI compliance and oversight platform for regulated financial services, has today announced that Specialist Mortgage Group, the Cardiff-based group behind Y3S Loans, Y3S Bridging and Commercial and Chase Blue Loans, has deployed its platform across their advice and quality-control process.

items.title: Access Partnership secures $13m in funding
items.snippet: Access Partnership (AP), the frontier technology advisory firm helping companies and governments bring innovation to market, today announced the successful completion of a capital raise that further strengthens its balance sheet and positions the firm for its next phase of growth.

items.title: Finovox launches ROI tool for fraud prevention
items.snippet: Fraud costs businesses far more than the amount lost in a fraudulent transaction. From hours spent investigating suspicious cases to lengthy processing times and operational costs, the true financial impact can be difficult to quantify.

items.title: GS Securities and Acuity Trading develop AI trading signals
items.snippet: GS Securities, the global online broker for forex and CFD trading, has partnered with award-winning market intelligence provider Acuity Trading to give its clients the full Acuity intelligence suite.
